filter_instruments.description: List every instrument matching keywords or filters, such as all common stock on one exchange or all Apple call options expiring this year, with how many match in all. Lists up to 100 at a time, with a page token for the next ones.
filter_instruments.name: filter_instruments

parameters.description: Words to look for, such as a company name or ticker. Leave empty to list by filters alone.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only instruments on this exchange, by OpenFIGI's code: US for every US exchange together, UN for the New York Stock Exchange, UW for NASDAQ Global Select, LN for London. Use this or MIC code, not both.
parameters.name: exchange_code

parameters.description: Only instruments on this market, by its ISO 10383 market identifier code (MIC), such as XNYS for the New York Stock Exchange or XLON for London. Use this or Exchange code, not both.
parameters.name: mic_code

parameters.description: Only instruments traded in this currency, such as USD or EUR. GBp is British pence, as London prices shares.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Only instruments in this market sector, such as Equity.
parameters.name: market_sector

parameters.description: Only instruments of this security type, such as Common Stock, ETP (exchange-traded funds and notes), ADR or Equity Option.
parameters.name: security_type

parameters.description: Only instruments of this broader security type, such as Common Stock, Option, Future, Bond or Mutual Fund.
parameters.name: security_type_2

parameters.description: Also find shares that aren't listed on an exchange, or no longer are. Turn on when a company you expect isn't found.
parameters.name: include_unlisted_equities

parameters.description: For options: calls, puts, or both.
parameters.name: option_type

parameters.description: For options: only strike prices of at least this much.
parameters.name: strike_from

parameters.description: For options: only strike prices of at most this much.
parameters.name: strike_to

parameters.description: For options, warrants and futures: only those expiring on or after this date. Alone, it searches the year after it.
parameters.name: expires_from

parameters.description: For options, warrants and futures: only those expiring on or before this date, at most a year after Expires from. Alone, it searches the year before it.
parameters.name: expires_to

parameters.description: The most instruments to list, up to 100.
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.description: To list the next instruments, the next_page_token of an earlier Filter instruments step with the same keywords and filters. Leave empty to start at the beginning.
parameters.name: page_token

count.description: How many instruments are listed here

has_more.description: Whether more instruments match after these

instruments.description: The instruments found, in FIGI order (oldest FIGIs first)

composite_figi.description: The composite FIGI, which groups the instrument's listings within one country, such as BBG000B9XRY4 for Apple shares in the United States. Empty for instruments without one, such as most bonds

details_available.description: False when OpenFIGI could show only the FIGI and not the instrument's other details

exchange_code.description: OpenFIGI's code for the exchange or venue, such as US (every US exchange together), UW (NASDAQ Global Select) or LN (London). Some instruments carry a venue name instead, such as TRACE for US bonds

exchange_country.description: The exchange's two-letter ISO country code, such as US or GB, when OpenFIGI's list of exchange codes gives one

exchange_name.description: The exchange's name from OpenFIGI's list of exchange codes, such as NASDAQ Global Select Market. Empty when the code isn't in that list

figi.description: The instrument's FIGI (Financial Instrument Global Identifier): 12 characters starting with BBG, such as BBG000B9XRY4, for one instrument on one trading venue. It never changes once issued

market_sector.description: The market sector, such as Equity, Corp (corporate bonds), Govt (government bonds) or Index

name.description: The issuer's or instrument's name, such as APPLE INC

security_description.description: OpenFIGI's short description of the security, such as AAPL or IBM US 03/20/10 C105

security_type.description: The security type, such as Common Stock, ETP, Equity Option or US GOVERNMENT

security_type_2.description: A broader security type, such as Common Stock, Option, Bond or Note

share_class_figi.description: The share class FIGI, which groups one share class's listings in every country, such as BBG001S5N8V8 for Apple's common shares. Empty for instruments without one

ticker.description: The ticker, such as AAPL. For a bond or an option it includes the coupon or strike and the date, such as AAPL 3.85 05/04/43

next_page_token.description: Put this in the Page token field of another Filter instruments step with the same keywords and filters to list the instruments after these. Empty on the last page

query.description: The keywords searched for, or empty when none were given

total.description: How many instruments match in all

list_field_values.description: List every value OpenFIGI accepts for a field: its identifier types, exchange codes (with each exchange's name and country), MIC codes, currencies, market sectors or security types. Narrow the list with a word.
list_field_values.name: list_field_values

parameters.description: Which field's values to list.
parameters.name: field

parameters.description: Only values, or exchange names, containing this text, in any capitals. Leave empty for every value.
parameters.name: contains

count.description: How many values are listed here

field.description: The field listed, such as exchange_code or currency

field_name.description: The field's name, such as Exchange codes

total.description: How many values the field accepts in all, before the Contains filter

values.description: The values the field accepts, A to Z

description.description: What the value means, where OpenFIGI publishes it: an exchange's name and country, or an identifier type's or market sector's name

value.description: The value exactly as OpenFIGI spells it, such as US or Common Stock

map_identifier.description: Look up an ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, ticker, FIGI or another identifier and get the instruments it names, one per exchange: each one's FIGI, composite and share class FIGIs, name, ticker, exchange and security type. Add an exchange code, such as US, to get just that listing.

description: Look up the Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI), the free and open identifier for shares, bonds, funds, options and other securities, with OpenFIGI, the service Bloomberg runs for it. Turn ISINs, CUSIPs, SEDOLs and tickers into FIGIs with each instrument's name, exchange and type, one at a time or ten at once, search instruments by name, and list instruments by exchange, currency or type. No account or API key required.
